title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: updated workspace memory in Copilot Workspaces
summary: Hold: the background guidance overstates what administrators can discover in Copilot memory and incorrectly describes enhanced personalization as controlling Copilot memory only. Microsoft excludes custom instructions from eDiscovery and also documents personalized recommendations under that control. The roadmap facts match, and targeted searches did not establish workspace-memory-specific defaults or controls.
